custom_expected:
Step 1: Delete checkbox unchecks.
Step 2: Schedule View and Create and Edit remain checked.
Step 3: Reports toggle slides to ON (blue).
Step 5: Create succeeds.
Step 7: Permission Summary shows Schedule has View+Create and Edit only (Delete OFF) and Reports is ON.
custom_preconds: Created from Service Advisor template, on Create Custom Role page.
custom_steps:
1. Locate the Schedule card. Uncheck the Delete checkbox (it is ON from the Service Advisor template).
  2. Verify Schedule View and Create and Edit remain checked.
  3. Locate the Page Access card. Toggle 'Reports' ON (it is OFF from the Service Advisor template).
  4. Fill 'Role name*' with 'QA Custom Role - Modified Service Advisor'.
  5. Click 'Create'.
  6. After save, return to the Roles & Permissions list. Open the new role with the eye icon.
  7. Inspect Schedule Delete and Reports toggle states in the Permission Summary.
title: User can modify any setting from the template defaults before saving
